title: Full internal/auth: Supabase JWT verification + team-membership authorization (RLS mirror)

plan_refs.section: current_profile_id(), is_team_member(), is_team_leader(), can_access_session(), team_members, team_role

goals.description: Real shared/kernel ID types: AuthUserID, ProfileID, TeamID, SessionID
platform/postgres pgx/v5 pool construction per §7.9 (transaction-pooler-safe exec mode, pool sizing from config)
auth/jwt.go: fetch+cache Supabase JWKS, verify RS256/ES256 JWT, extract sub as AuthUserID
auth/authorizer.go: ResolveProfileID, IsTeamMember, IsTeamLeader, CanAccessSession — exact Go mirror of the schema's SQL helpers of the same names
auth/cache.go: TTL<=60s membership cache wrapping the authorizer, per §5.6
httpapi/middleware/auth.go (JWT->ProfileID on context) and authz.go (per-route team/session checks), wired as real Gin middleware
One protected example route (GET /v1/me) proving the full chain end to end, plus unit tests for jwt verification, authorizer logic (fake DB), and cache TTL behavior
